anuak.area_text_en: A small tract on the Sobat between the Dinka (west) and Nuer (east), ending at Wegin; eastern Anuak on the Baro east of 34° 10' E up to the Baro gorge; mostly in Ethiopia

azande.area_text_en: Mbomu valley and as far south as the Vela (Uele); Zandeland on the Sudan–Congo–CAR border

dinka.area_text_en: Mostly the grassy flood-plains of the Bahr al-Ghazal; some on the east bank of the White Nile

nuer.area_text_en: On the Sobat and Baro from about 32° 33' to about 34° 10' E (1905)

shilluk.area_text_en: Upper Nile: villages along the west bank of the White Nile near Malakal; Shillukland reached from Aba Island to the mouth of the Sobat (1862 eyewitness account); royal seat at Fashoda from c.1690-1710

properties.detail_en: Widely distributed over the northern part of the southern region, particularly Upper Nile (Aali an Nil) and Bahr al Ghazal. Transhumant cattle-keepers. Anchor point only; text only.
properties.detail_ar: منتشرون في الجزء الشمالي من الإقليم الجنوبي، خاصة أعالي النيل وبحر الغزال. رعاة ماشية يمارسون الترحال الموسمي. [يحتاج تحقق]

properties.label_en: Jebelein: northern limit of Dinka country on the White Nile (c.1900)
properties.label_ar: الجبلين: الحد الشمالي لديار الدينكا على النيل الأبيض (نحو 1900) [يحتاج تحقق]
properties.detail_en: Right (east) bank of the White Nile. Gleichen adds that the stretch was 'uninhabited, however, except by Nomad Selim, north of Karshawal'.

cite.quote: The Dinka country on the White Nile, extends from Jebelein southwards to about 10 miles south of Kodok, along the right bank

properties.coord_source: Wikidata P625 of Q3720937 (Al Jabalayn, Sudan)

properties.label_en: Kodok: southern limit of Dinka country on the White Nile is about 10 miles south of here (c.1900)
properties.label_ar: كودوك: يقع الحد الجنوبي لديار الدينكا على النيل الأبيض على بعد نحو 10 أميال جنوبها (نحو 1900) [يحتاج تحقق]
properties.detail_en: Point is Kodok itself; the stated limit lies about 10 miles further south and is not plotted (offset not computed).

cite.quote: The Dinka country on the White Nile, extends from Jebelein southwards to about 10 miles south of Kodok, along the right bank

properties.coord_source: Wikidata P625 of Q1888763 (Kodok, Upper Nile)

properties.label_en: Nasser Post (Nasir): inside Nuer territory on the Sobat (c.1900)
properties.label_ar: الناصر: داخل ديار النوير على السوباط (نحو 1900) [يحتاج تحقق]
properties.detail_en: Interior point, not a limit. Gleichen p.132 gives the Nuer reach along the Sobat and Baro as 'from about east 32° 33' to about 34° 10''; those meridians are recorded in text only (no river geometry on the box to place them).

cite.quote: [From Wegin village to] Nasser Post the country is probably the finest occupied by the Nuers

properties.coord_source: Wikidata P625 of Q1965843 (Nasir, Upper Nile)

properties.label_en: Pibor–Akobo junction (Akobo): southern end of the Nuer reach on the Pibor (1901)
properties.label_ar: ملتقى البيبور وأكوبو (أكوبو): الطرف الجنوبي لامتداد النوير على البيبور (1901) [يحتاج تحقق]
properties.detail_en: Edge point (Austin 1901, quoted by Gleichen): Nuer along the Pibor up to the junction, an Anuak dry-season colony at it. Akobo town stands at the junction.

cite.quote: along the River Pibor through Nuer territory until we reached the junction of that river with the Akobo. Here we found a small colony of Anuaks

properties.label_en: Itang: enclave inside eastern Anuak territory on the Baro (c.1904)
properties.label_ar: إيتانغ: جيب داخل ديار الأنواك الشرقية على البارو (نحو 1904) [يحتاج تحقق]
properties.detail_en: Interior point. Coordinate is the Wikidata point of Itang woreda (the Itang town item Q114252208 has no coordinate). Western limit 34° 10' E and eastern limit at the Baro gorge are recorded in text only.

cite.quote: The eastern Anuaks of the Baro ... inhabit that portion of the river bank extending east of 34° 10' to the mouth of the Baro river gorge ... with the exception of a small enclave round Itang

properties.coord_source: Wikidata P625 of Q3155900 (Itang woreda, Gambela; town item has no P625)

properties.label_en: Pibor–Akobo junction (Akobo): Anuak dry-season colony at the Nuer edge (1901)
properties.label_ar: ملتقى البيبور وأكوبو (أكوبو): مستوطنة أنواك موسمية عند طرف ديار النوير (1901) [يحتاج تحقق]
properties.detail_en: Western edge point. Gleichen p.137 also says 'The Anuak territory terminates at the junction of the Akobo and Ajibur streams' (eastern limit on the Akobo; Ajibur junction has no Wikidata item, not plotted).

cite.quote: until we reached the junction of that river with the Akobo. Here we found a small colony of Anuaks settled down for the coming dry season

properties.detail_en: A compact strip on the west bank of the Nile, from Tonga to Muomo near the Nile–Sobat confluence; villages lined the bank for about 100 miles. Fashoda, founded by Reth Tugo, became the permanent royal seat. Anchor point only; text only.
properties.detail_ar: شريط متصل على الضفة الغربية للنيل من تونجا إلى مومو قرب ملتقى النيل والسوباط، وتمتد القرى على الضفة نحو 100 ميل. وأصبحت فشودة التي أسسها الرث توجو مقراً ملكياً دائماً. [يحتاج تحقق]
